description: Disable fast mode cooldown in 2.1.228: the rate-limit cooldown writes runtimeState={status:"cooldown",resetAt,reason} on the fast-mode state machine; force the recorded status to "active" (padded to same length) so the cooldown never engages and fast mode is never suspended.

patches.description: enterCooldown: recorded status cooldown -> active (same length)

note: runtimeState cooldown JS shape absent; bare cooldown token too generic (many hits).
